name: Vishnuteja Ambati
tagline: Computer Engineering at Iowa State · AI systems, research & real-time engineering

paragraphs: I’m Vishnu, a Computer Engineering student at Iowa State University, pursuing a minor in AI. I transferred from BITS Pilani after two years of studying Computer Science.
I’m a Founding Engineer at Hivemind ↗ (opens in a new tab), where I’m building Iris, an AI portfolio-intelligence platform.

I build software and intelligent systems—from backend infrastructure and system design to distributed systems, real-time computer vision, LLM applications, and AI/ML. I’m interested in building reliable systems that work beyond the prototype and hold up in production.
